description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wathuragama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511002 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
